# libass fork rendering fixtures

Fonts for `libass_renderer_tests` LibassFork.*, which pin how the altqx/libass
fork (`ports/libass`) renders where it differs from libass 0.17.5, the
version legacy HikariSub pins (`Thirdparty/libass` at `4a05d81`, "Release
0.17.5").

The four fonts and `gen_fonts.py` are copied unchanged from the fork's
`compare/fork-test/` at `4f5ea43630bb89c9caacaf4742a8af4f3e26edf7`. They are
generated by `gen_fonts.py` (fontTools) and dedicated to the public domain
(CC0 1.0). Every glyph draws the low 12 bits of its code as a grid of squares,
so a glyph taken from the wrong code is visible.

- `forktest-symf020.ttf`: a (3,0) symbol cmap at U+F020..F07E, the usual
  layout. 0.17.5 renders it too.
- `forktest-symf120.ttf`: a (3,0) symbol cmap at U+F120..F17E.
- `forktest-sym0020.ttf`: a (3,0) symbol cmap at U+0020..007E, PANOSE
  pictorial.
- `forktest-arabic.ttf`: a (3,1) Unicode cmap with legacy simplified Arabic
  glyphs at their private-use codes, charset 178 in the high byte of OS/2
  fsSelection.

libass 0.17.5 draws nothing for the last three. The fork draws them, through
upstream libass's changes after 0.17.5 (`057a533`, the symbol base offset from
the first cmap code; `b085eeb`, legacy Arabic charsets on Unicode cmaps). See
the LF-libass-cmap row in `docs/qt/compatibility-decisions.md`.
